## Governance & Capstone Sprint

**Learning goals**

- Operationalize monitoring + documentation expectations
- Apply explainability tooling in an app context
- Deliver the ESG-aware treasury analytics capstone

## Governance Toolkit

- Model cards / fact sheets
- Approval workflow (1st line → MRM → governance committee)
- Monitoring hooks: drift metrics, alerting, incident response checklist
- Mapping to OCC SR 11-7 & ECB model risk guide

## Explainability & Transparency

- Use SHAP/feature importance to explain issuer recommendations
- Communicate limitations (data coverage, priors, fairness results)
- Do/Don’t for disclosures:
  - ✅ Plain language on drivers & policies
  - ❌ Overstating accuracy or ignoring known gaps

## Capstone Narrative

- Problem: treasury teams must allocate cash responsibly under ESG mandates
- Solution: "ESG-Aware Treasury Advisor" app combining data validation, policy engine, explainability
- Tech stack: Python, pandas, scikit-learn, Gradio/Streamlit

## Architecture Snapshot

1. **Data ingestion** – ESG & yield CSVs, validation log
2. **Policy engine** – min ESG thresholds, weight caps
3. **Analytics** – portfolio allocation + yield prediction model
4. **Explainability** – SHAP bar plots
5. **UI** – Gradio / Streamlit with sliders, tables, exports

## Sprint Checklist

- Finalize datasets (copy from Drive)
- Define team roles (data, model, UX, documentation)
- Stand-up cadence: plan → build → check-in → dry run
- Track tasks on shared board (Miro/Trello/whiteboard)

## Deliverables

- Running demo (Gradio share link or Streamlit+ngrok URL) + screenshot
- Model card + audit log entry
- Pitch slide deck (3–4 slides) articulating value & controls
- Reflection note (≤250 words) on risks mitigated

## Presentation Guidelines

- 3-minute demo + 2-minute Q&A per team
- Cover: problem, approach, responsible controls, roadmap
- Use rubric dimensions (data integrity, policy engine, explainability, UX, governance, presentation)

## Wrap-Up & Next Steps

- Submit artifacts via LMS by end of day
- Post-course: digital badge + alumni community invite
- Suggested follow-ons: advanced fairness, MRM automation, certification tracks

Thank you for building responsibly!
